description: Primary book: identical to the pre-registered v1 spec (config/strategy_v1.json) except that the catalyst and momentum sleeves are disabled, because both failed the pre-registered in-sample test (see research/PREREGISTRATION.md). Holds SPY with residual cash while the regime is risk-on; cash when risk-off or when the drawdown halt triggers.

regime.note: Risk-on requires SPY close > 200d SMA and VIX below threshold (hysteresis: 30 to turn off, 25 to turn back on). Risk-off: exit everything at the next opportunity and hold cash.

catalyst.note: Reaction day R = announcement date if announced before 12:00 ET, else the next session. Signal evaluated after R's close; entry at the next session's open (or next available price).

risk.note: Drawdown measured on end-of-day equity vs running peak. Pause blocks new single-stock entries; halt liquidates everything and blocks all buys (for the live 30-day experiment this effectively means cash until the end).

costs.note: Per-side cost applied as an adverse price adjustment (buys fill higher, sells lower). Covers half-spread plus slippage; deliberately conservative for liquid large caps.

data.note: Signals require the most recent completed session's bar to be present and valid; otherwise that ticker (or, for SPY/VIX, the whole decision) is skipped.

news.role: confirmation and veto only; news never triggers a trade by itself
